title: IT Strategy
lead: The plan that aligns IT capabilities, investments and sourcing decisions with business objectives.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: IT strategy defines how the IT function will support and enable the organisation's goals over a multi-year horizon. It covers the portfolio of IT services, sourcing model, technology architecture, governance and the roadmap for change. A clear IT strategy is the prerequisite for designing an effective IT Operating Model.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: The IT Operating Model is the operationalisation of the IT strategy. Every ITOM engagement begins with validating or developing the IT strategy, as it drives all decisions about organisation design, process architecture, platform choices and governance structure.

items.desc: Decision rights and accountability structures for IT investment and delivery.
The mix of in-house, outsourced and cloud-delivered IT capabilities.
Multi-year plan for platform evolution and legacy retirement.
Prioritisation of IT projects and products relative to business value.
The structural design of systems, data, infrastructure and integration.
